comparison.objective: Populate server memory one DIMM per channel using first slots first, rather than remove HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Slot identification, DIMM orientation, edge alignment, insertion, and latch engagement versus mandrel stabilization, hammer impact, and fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Title requires correct channel distribution and slot order; no DIMM count, insertion/latch checks, or full rubric is available. It does not test fracture or retained coils.
comparison.reason: Both involve precise insertion, but DIMM seating and latching are meaningfully different from impact-driven notch fracture.
